_meta.notice: ALL SCENARIOS ARE SYNTHETIC. They are invented examples for exploring the app. They are not real incidents, real locations or verified facilities.

scenarios.title: Electronic waste
scenarios.summary: Retired lab computers and loose phone batteries, objective: investigate both recovery and disposal.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Regulated stream: recovery is investigated through authorized channels only, with a disposal check.

case.waste_name: Retired desktop PCs, keyboards and loose phone batteries
case.description: About 12 old desktop computers, keyboards and a bag of loose phone batteries from a school computer lab. No damage reported.

scenarios.title: Agricultural residue
scenarios.summary: Rice straw after harvest, objective: recover value.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Routine stream: recovery options are investigated.

case.description: Rice straw left after harvest on a two-acre field. Dry and clean.

scenarios.title: Used industrial oil
scenarios.summary: Used engine oil in sealed drums, objective: dispose safely.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Regulated stream: authorized disposal pathway is checked.

case.description: About 40 litres of used engine oil from a small garage, stored in sealed labelled drums.
case.danger_info: Not mixed with other liquids as far as the owner knows.

scenarios.title: Unknown chemical container
scenarios.summary: Unlabelled drum, user hopes to recover value. The safety guardrail should block recovery and escalate.
scenarios.expected_behavior: High-risk: recovery is blocked by the guardrail; the case is escalated to qualified assessment.

case.description: An unlabelled blue plastic drum found behind a workshop. Contents unknown.
case.danger_info: Unlabelled. Faint chemical smell reported by a passer-by.

scenarios.title: Leaking battery (emergency wording)
scenarios.summary: A battery pack that is swollen and leaking, to show the emergency path.
scenarios.expected_behavior: Emergency flag: immediate escalation with an emergency warning.

case.description: A power bank with a swollen casing that is leaking liquid and giving off fumes.
